**How to read the counts.** PASS = the number has a store key, its state is right (LIVE, or CLOSED with its time / "closed, last Fri 15:30" on the row, title, panel or the page's market strip) and, where an outside source exists, it equals that source (3,360 PASS rows were compared value for value with an outside source; the rest are freshness-only). FAIL = wrong value, or old value without its time, or STALE. UNCHECKABLE = the number has no outside source (counts, page numbers, labels, thresholds, server-made scores, desk/AI figures, news times) or the extractor could not tie it to one store key; most of the UNCHECKABLE rows are page text such as "1-4 of 43", "F1", "3-trade cap", rule numbers on Help / Settings. The automatic matcher ties a shown number to a store value by its digits + the names on the row, so a few FAIL rows below are near-misses of the matcher (noted).

## FIXES MADE (all with backups; BUILD_LOG.md rows 21 Nov 23:51 - 22 Nov 00:4x)

1. **Index times** (preview.py): BANKNIFTY / SENSEX / VIX / FINNIFTY said "last value from 23:38 IST" for Friday's close (the page server's call time) -> the last session's 15:30. Same for the sector rotation data (sec.rot, "23:37" -> Fri 15:30).
2. **India VIX WRONG** 17.33 +7.57% (last Kite tick) vs NSE's official close **17.32 +7.51%** -> closed market takes NSE's official close (new kb/fetch_nseidx.py, one request a day at 20:45 in run_topup_daily.sh; v2/data/ext/nse_ind_close.json). BANKNIFTY / FINNIFTY / NIFTY already equal NSE.
3. **Futures OI WRONG** (preview.py): futlive.json's 15:31 snapshot differed from NSE's F&O bhavcopy - near-month OI off by > 5% on 220 of 223 names, OI change and build-up words wrong (e.g. RELIANCE NOV: shown OI 5.28 cr, +5.69 L, SHORT BUILD-UP; NSE 2.82 cr, -1.90 cr -> LONG UNWINDING near month / LONG BUILD-UP all months). After the close fut.* now = NSE F&O bhavcopy of the last session (official close, OI, OI change; build-up recomputed the futlive way); sh.* build-up follows.
4. **Option chains WRONG** (preview.py): chain last prices / OI were 15:14-15:30 snapshots (NIFTY 25,450 CE shown 357.00, NSE close 347.15; 6,640 of 10,389 legs' OI differed) -> NSE official close + OI after the close; chain PCR + max pain recomputed from all strikes; strip PCR NIFTY 1.18 / BANKNIFTY 0.93 (15:14 ATM band) -> **1.67 / 1.37** (official close OI, 23 Nov expiry).
5. **Weekend false STALE** (preview.py): kb.watch (made Fri 20:49 for Mon 23 Nov) and strip.expiry / mkt.daytype (contract master of the last session) were red STALE all weekend -> CLOSED "market closed - normal".
6. **His position premiums 10 min early** (intraday/pnlbook.py): gir-pnlwatch read positions 09:15-15:30 but F&O trades to 15:40 since NSE CAS (3 Aug 2026); one open position's last price differed from NSE's 20 Nov last / close by about 3.5% -> watch window 09:15-15:40 (from Monday; read only). The weekend P&L shown stays Kite's 15:30:57 reading (matches gir-pnlwatch).
7. **Hang Seng WRONG** -3.79% (prev 23,294.8 = 18 Nov's close) -> **-1.89%** (19 Nov close 22,841.62, daily bars) on World / drivers / Sectors / Analyst (sources/p_uswrap.py: the daily bars it already reads win when the 1-day chart's previous close is an older session; no new request).
8. **Strip / phone time**: market strip "data age not known" -> "closed, last Fri 15:30"; phone status row "32h" -> "CLOSED Fri 15:30" (fits 390 px).
9. Reviewer 22 Nov 00:20 lines (see table) - footer wording, developer text, expiry wording, rotation strip, Friday verdicts, old plan / prediction / shock lines, held-PE conflict line.
